name: playwright-bdd-framework
description: BDD test automation framework using Playwright, Cucumber, and TypeScript

scripts.run:all: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --require support/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --format @cucumber/pretty-formatter tests/features/**/*.feature
scripts.run:tag: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --require support/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --format @cucumber/pretty-formatter tests/features/**/*.feature --tags
scripts.report:all: npm run run:all && npm run report:generate
scripts.report:tag: npm run run:tag -- --tags @API && npm run report:generate
